description_en: This free-standing three-bay Phalcā faces east and is located in the north of Thati courtyard. Dabū Phalcā contains carved wooden pillars (dhaliṃkhvāḥ)and small windows which can be dated back to the 17th century. Six old columns withkalasamotifs, a capital showing a dragon, small windows and rare panels have been preserved. The Phalcā's roof is covered withjhĩgaṭītiles and has been recently repaired by a Khaḍgī at his own cost. Inside, one can find two inscriptions and a statue of Padmapāṇi Lokeśvara.The chariot of Matsyendranātha stops at the ThatiṬolafor several days, where it rests in the public space between this and two otherphalcās. One of theinscriptions in this Phalcā mentions that it was constructed in 1704 CE (NS 824) by Narahari Bhāro and his wife Vasumuni, residents of Dhopogatra (present Dhaugala ṭola) during the reign of Yoganarendra Malla. The same inscription mentions the construction of a stage platform (dabū), though this has since been removed.The second inscription states that Siddhivajra Vajrācārya from Hiraṇyavarṇa Mahāvihāra recitedGuṇakāraṇyavyūhaat the chariot procession of Matsyendranātha in 1868 CE (NS 988). The inscription does not mention whether the recitation took place inside the Phalcā or somewhere else. The building was reconstructed one month after this recitation took place. A representative of each of the four major Vihāras of Patan was involved in both the recitation and the reconstruction process. No religious or cultural activities are observed hereany longer.
description_ne: थति टोलको व्यस्त चोकबाट इति टोलतिर लाग्ने बाटो छेउमा (उत्तरमा) यो फल्चा अवस्थित छ । ३ कवलको फल्चा पूर्वाभिमुख छ । यो चारैतिर कुनै अर्को संरचनालाई नछोई स्वत्रन्त्र उभिएको (free standing) फल्चा हो ।  फल्चामा बट्टेदार काष्ठ थामोका साथै, धलिंख्वाः र साना झ्यालहरू रहेका छन् जुन १७ औं शताब्दीका हुन्  (Basukalā & Gutschow, 2018: XX) । फल्चाको छानो परमपरागत झिंगति शैलीको रहेको छ । फल्चाभित्र दुई अभिलेखका साथै पद्मपाणी लोकेश्वरको शिलाको मूर्ति रहेका छन् । थति टोलको चोकमा बुङ्गद्यःको रथ लामो समयका लागि रोकिने भएकोले यहाँ ४ वटै फल्चाहरू बुङ्खद्यःको नाममा बनाइएको पाइएको छ र सबै फल्चाहरूको मोहोडा भाग बुङ्खद्यःको रथ रोकिने चोकतिर फर्काई बनाइएको पाइएको छ ।फल्चामा भएको अभिलेख अनुसार यस फल्चाको  निर्माण राजा योगनरेद्रको राज्यकाल अर्थात् ने.सं. ८२४ मा गरिएको थियो । धोपोगत्रका (हालको धौगल टोल) नरहरि भारो र उनकी पत्नी वसुमुनिले फल्चा बनाएको चर्चा छ । फल्चाका साथै सोही समय डबली बनाएको चर्चा पनि परेको छ तर हाल फल्चा आसपास कुनै डवलीको अवशेष भएको भेटिदैन । फल्चामा भएको अर्को अभिलेख अनुसार ने.सं. ९८८ वैशाख शुक्ल १ देखि बुङ्गद्यःको जात्राको समय हिरण्यवर्ण महाविहार, सरस्वती ननिका सिद्धिवज्र ब्राचार्यलाई गुणकारण्डब्यूह पुराण पाठ गर्न लगाइयो । यसरी पाठ गर्न लगाइएको डेढ महिना पछि, अर्थात् जेष्ठ शुक्ल १५ का दिन फल्चाको जिर्णोद्धार कार्य समापन गरिएको चर्चा अभिलेखमा छ । पुराणको पाठ फल्चामै गर्न लगाइएको हो वा अन्त कतै बसी गरेको हो अभिलेखमा उल्लखे छैन । पाटनका चार विहारबाट एक–एक गरी चारजनाको समुहले पुराण पाठ एवं फल्चा जिर्णोद्धार गराएका हुन् ।फल्चाको छानोको सामान्य मर्मतकार्य हालसालै एक खड्गी थरका व्यक्तिको व्यक्तिगत खर्चमा गरिएको हो । फल्चामा कुनै धार्मिक एवं सांस्कृतिक गतिविधि भएगरेको पाइदैन ।

historical_events.event_description: Narahari Bhāro and his wife Vasumuni, residents of Dhopogatra (present Dhaugala ṭola) facilitated the construction of this Phalcā.

historical_events.event_name: Recitation of Guṇakāraṇḍavyūha text and renovation of the Phalcā
historical_events.event_description: A ritual expert from Hiraṇyavarṇa Mahāvihāra recitesGuṇakāraṇdavyūhaat the chariot procession of Matsyendranātha. This was related to the renovation of the building that took place one year later.

Lalitpur Metropolitan City and Lumanti (a NGO) provided some necessary equipment to locals that may be useful in a natural disaster. Some of this is still stored haphazardly in the Phalcā. An iron fence was also fixed around the Phalcā.
The roof was renovated and some of the original struts and joists were replaced with new ones. The main donor was a person from the Khaḍgī caste, Thati ṭola.
